Alyssa Ahn is an American tennis player. She has a career high WTA tennis ranking of No. 717 achieved on 18 August 2025. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Career [ edit ] From San Diego , California, [ 3 ] she committed in 2025 to attend Stanford University to play for the Stanford Cardinal . [ 4 ] Ahn won the USTA Girls’ 16s National Championships in 2022. [ citation needed ] She earned a wildcard into the main draw of the US Open after victory in the USTA Girls’ 18s National Championships in California in August 2025 when she defeated Maya Iyengar in straight sets for the loss of only three games.
